translations.web: “ ‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
translations.bsb: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.
translations.kjv: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
translations.asv: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.
